title: Project: LocalServe booking platform
text: LocalServe is a Local Service Booking Platform. Customers book electricians, plumbers and tutors by time slot, providers manage their availability, and admins monitor users and bookings (3-role RBAC). The Spring Boot REST API is secured with JWT authentication, Spring Security role-based access and BCrypt password hashing.

title: LocalServe tech stack and architecture
text: LocalServe uses Java, Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, React, MySQL, JWT, Docker and RBAC. Features: slot conflict prevention so a time slot cannot be double-booked, email notifications, a calendar booking UI and a provider dashboard. React frontend on Vercel, Spring Boot backend on Render, MySQL on Aiven.
